thread:
sara: heads up — seeing a weird pattern in prod eu-west-1 around 16:02 UTC: clients spike reconnects, then get stuck in a persistent backoff/replay loop. console shows overlapping session_count and billing_count diverging by ~12% :thinking:

mike: logs? any error codes from proxy/edge?

sara: snippets below — lots of repeated 429 from proxy, then immediate client reconnects. looks like backoff state isn't sticky.
```
2026-03-21T16:02:11Z proxy-01 tenant=teamA status=429 msg="rate limit" route=sticky-42
2026-03-21T16:02:12Z edge-02 tenant=teamA client=abc resume_id=xyz reconnect_attempt=1
2026-03-21T16:02:12Z edge-02 tenant=teamA client=abc resume_id=xyz reconnect_attempt=2
2026-03-21T16:02:13Z router-01 tenant=teamA tombstone_hit=false
```

alex: we shipped the sticky-route change yesterday — @deploy-bot did the deploy at ~15:50 UTC. possible lease/tombstone propagation gap?

deploy-bot: deployed eng-platform/sticky-routing v2 (build 20260321.15) to prod at 15:50 UTC by jenkins-canary

jess: dashboard note: session_active stays high while resume_requests show sharp spikes then drop — telemetry tagging for route_id seems delayed, so console aggregates look wrong. also alerts don't surface trace ids so debugging is slow.

tom: reproable in staging? if we can simulate a proxy 429 and immediate client reconnect we can assert whether backoff resets on certain responses. Also check token-bucket state in router.

mike: ran a quick staging loadtest — if gatekeeper returns intermittent 503/429 and then a 204/empty-body appears, client lib seems to reset backoff timer and retry aggressively. code path: on non-fatal http response we currently call reconnect() without honoring previous backoff.

sara: immediate mitigation options: revert sticky-routing or enforce server-side tombstones/rate limit so clients are rejected for a TTL instead of allowed to reconnect immediately. I prefer server-side tombstone because revert is noisy for traffic.

alex: agree on tombstone. minimal hotfix: router should set a tombstone on tenant-route when we return 429 and emit Retry-After header so well-behaved clients backoff. Also ensure tombstone propagates to edge cache asynchronously.

jess: console/telemetry asks: add a "recent-reconnects" per-route chart and tag metrics with last-deploy metadata. also emit metric 'sse.tombstone.hit' and 'sse.tombstone.set' so we can correlate.

tom: patch plan: in router on 429 -> set tombstone[tenant-route]=ttl(30s), return header Retry-After: 30. add metric sse.tombstone.set++ and sse.tombstone.evicted on expiry. quick PR and 1hr hotfix window?

sara: yes. open PR, we can canary to 10% first. tag @mike @tom for code review. also update runbook note about backoff behavior.

mike: opening PR now — pr/1234 (WIP) — includes tombstone logic + Retry-After header + metric hooks. link: (placeholder)

deploy-bot: canary rollout started for pr/1234 to 10% at 17:12 UTC

alex: monitoring: watch billing_count vs active_sessions divergence. if delta > 5% across 2 minutes -> roll back.

jess: I'll add dashboard tiles and the alert; will also append last-deploy tag to the alert payload. :thumbsup:

sara: thanks — keeping this thread for any follow-ups and postmortem if we need to revert. please paste traces and sampling links here once available.
